title: FDA De Novo grant: Caristo Diagnostics , Ltd. — CaRi-Heart (DEN250042)

triage.summary: FDA granted Caristo's CaRi-Heart a De Novo on 2026-07-28 (DEN250042), creating product code SIU, 'Predictive Indicator For Long-Term Cardiovascular Outcomes', under a new regulation 870.2215. The decision summary PDF is not yet posted; the collector will retry.
triage.why_it_matters: First US authorization of a CCTA-derived long-term cardiac risk prediction claim, and a brand-new regulatory category. Any company wanting a prognostic claim, including Cleerly, can now use SIU as a 510(k) pathway, and Caristo gets first-mover positioning on outcomes prediction.
